rules.statement: The absence of an agreement and lack of evidence indicating that sums were payable on demand precludes such a finding.
rules.supporting_quote: (i) No agreement has been placed in evidence and there is no evidence to the effect that the sums overdrawn became payable only on demand. (ii) Claim in respect of the overdraft is time barred in as much as a period of over 3 years had lapsed by the date of institution of action since last payment by the Defendant Respondent

rules.statement: A claim for an overdraft is time-barred if more than three years have passed since the last payment by the defendant without any intervening legal action to restart the limitation period.
